findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: watch_add, watch_portfolio, verify_bulk, check_document · Private data: buy_card_package, check_entity_file, check_entity_file_il, check_entity_file_ca, check_sanctions, verify_citation, watch_add, watch_portfolio, verify_bulk, check_document · Public sink: check_figure, check_entity_file, verify_citation, verify_package, watch_add, verify_bulk, check_document.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: watch_add, watch_portfolio, verify_bulk, check_document · Private data: buy_card_package, check_entity_file, check_entity_file_il, check_entity_file_ca, check_sanctions, verify_citation, watch_add, watch_portfolio, verify_bulk, check_document · Public sink: check_figure, check_entity_file, verify_citation, verify_package, watch_add, verify_bulk, check_document

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
